name: ChatPion BOT/Messenger Campaign Operations

included: Meta Campaign Ops with Messenger destination
campaign creation and cloning through Campaign Engine v3
excluded_by_default: Smart Bidding template or route configuration

mechanisms.campaign_write: manifest -> validate -> plan -> final summary -> request approval -> execute -> consolidated readback
mechanisms.recovery: readback-first, same request, persisted IDs, missing-or-invalid layer only
mechanisms.state_isolation: state, audit, locks, denylist, baselines and performance are consumer-scoped
mechanisms.parameter_resolution: explicit authorized request -> active operation override -> family mechanism; missing operation value fails closed
mechanisms.serving_proof: ACTIVE is insufficient; delivery claims require impression, spend or equivalent live insight
mechanisms.cron: trigger only; operation-scoped schedule, global collision inventory and shared-resource locks required

operation_parameters_required: Pages, UTMs, pixel/event and Messenger JSON
campaign structure, copy, naming and creative policy
thresholds, comparators, phases, schedules and budget policy
report sources, joins, freshness and renderer
Discord routes, prompts, runners, state and audit paths

change_control.family_change: update family sources and project affected routes plus rules for every active consumer
change_control.operation_change: update only the selected consumer contract/runtime and project affected route plus rules
change_control.reusable_extraction: promote reusable procedure only; retain values and exceptions in the operation contract
change_control.supersession: one active version per canonical key; prior version remains historical and points to its successor
